correctness.rationale: Delete the k marked leaves adjacent to v and obtain a uniform n-k Cayley tree conditional on v being a leaf; the Prüfer word of length n-k-2 avoids v and is i.i.d. uniform on b=n-k-1 other labels. This yields exact marked-event probability and conditional L=k+empty-box count, giving covariance by indicator expansion. Sign: analytic logarithmic bounds (b+1/2)/e < h_b < (b+3/4)/e and (n+3/2)/e < f_n < (n+45/16)/e (n>=5) force k=1 negative and k>=2 positive; n=4 k1 direct. Asymptotic expansion yields coefficient e^-(k+1)/k!*(k-(k+2)/e). n-1 star leaves occur unconditionally but not under marked event, and for k>=2 higher conditional mean excludes reverse dominance. New independent exact enumeration of all Prüfer words for n=4..7 confirms all signs and rational covariances, including k1 n=4 -3/8 and n5 k1 -204/625, k2 132/625.

originality.rationale: Junk–Schmidt–Weber 2020 original article Section 3 (Lemmas 3.5–3.8) computes existence/counts/second moment of strict cherries (k=2) for Cayley trees; its k2 marginal is already known and explicitly credited. The current result concerns the joint finite-n covariance with total leaves and the strict sign switch at k=2, plus all-k marked conditional occupancy law, which is not stated there. Janson 2020 article Section 9/Remark 9.3 concerns convergence of conditioned Galton–Watson random trees including labeled Cayley trees, not these exact finite-n mixed moments. Resultary hits on random recursive trees/other Cayley statistics are distinct.
